title: Where Haverline Casualty's seventeen Early Return Nursing teams work in 2027 and the AY2027 indemnity they save
subdomain: claims-frequency-severity (a workers' compensation nurse programme's saving read as indemnity per assigned intake, frequency times severity, from a randomised pilot, valued per nurse place-day)
prompt_shape: 05: seventeen teams allocated across eight segments (teams and saving per team-year for every segment, the AY2027 credit), the note's chart, and two per-segment asks (2025 intakes; indemnity paid January to September 2026)

sources.origin: constructed for this task by task139/generator/build.py (seeded, deterministic) around a fictional Missouri workers' compensation carrier (Haverline Casualty Company), its consulting actuaries (Kellerman Pryce Actuarial), claim units and people; no real organisation, person, employer or claim is depicted. NCCI classification codes and Missouri benefit rules are used descriptively.
